baselineReadSmoke.note: Empty-input GET probes provide baseline input/error evidence, not full behavioral qualification.

sourceRemediation.issue: Schema allowed empty filters while handler required name or componentType, producing HTTP 500 on empty input.
sourceRemediation.fix: Added anyOf schema requirement for name or componentType so invalid empty requests fail before handler execution.

uiFallbackRemediation.issue: Creator 3.7.3 does not provide the default_ui Label, Button, or Sprite prefabs.
uiFallbackRemediation.fix: Create native nodes and components when those internal prefabs are absent; resolve component and child paths from Creator query-node dumps.

verification.focusedLiveTest: 1/1 pass with three created component types and cleanup
verification.textSmoke: createLabel and createButton returned HTTP 200 with optional text

baselineLedger.note: Conservative one-to-one ledger classification. Broad live tests pass, but tools without direct endpoint evidence remain registered-unverified.

fullLiveQualification.scope: live contract and behavior coverage; not a one-test-per-registered-tool ledger

status.note: This check proves live endpoint, Creator 3.7.3 identity, exact 86-name source/manual reconciliation, baseline GET smoke behavior, corrected findNodes validation, and native Label/Button/Sprite creation fallback. It does not qualify every tool behavior.
